item.title: Q&A: By analyzing media coverage, researchers connect public sentiment hedge fund returns
item.description: Economists have long used measures of public sentiment about the economy to forecast a wide range of key financial outcomes, like consumer spending and gross domestic product growth. item.title: "La fastidié": Denzel Washington se arrepiente desde hace 31 años de haber rechazado uno de los mejores thrillers de la historia
item.description: Si le preguntas a cualquier amante del thiller por su top tres, es bastante probable que ' Seven ' haga acto de presencia. item.title: An empty bus pulled into Ridgland Farms in Wisconsin last week and emerged with more than 150 rescued beagles – who had never felt grass or fresh air in their lives. More than 2,000 beagles had been already rescued from the farm, a controversial biomedical research and breeding facility. CBS News' Adam Yamaguchi got to be there as the remaining dogs – many of them puppies – had their first taste of freedom. Many of the dogs were paralyzed with fear as they finally exited the cages they had been trapped in and entered the unknown world of caring human beings and safety. After protesters tried to break into the facility to rescue the dogs earlier this year, the facility decided to shut down its breeding operations. The remaining beagles were taken to Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Florida, where they will be put up for adoption. #beagles #rescue #dogrescue #dogs | CBS News
